risk: Customers in different regions may receive inconsistent recommendations
preventive_control: Use representative business data and segment-aware evaluation
detective_control: Compare response quality and escalation rates across regions

risk: Agent may provide incorrect payment or delivery information
preventive_control: Ground responses in approved order records and validate outputs
detective_control: Regression tests, evaluation and incident monitoring

risk: Customer information may be disclosed to unauthorized users
preventive_control: Data minimization, authentication and authorization before retrieval
detective_control: Access-control tests and data exposure monitoring

risk: Customers using different languages or accessibility modes may receive poor service
preventive_control: Design accessible interactions and supported language experiences

risk: Customer may believe an AI recommendation is an executed transaction
preventive_control: Clearly distinguish recommendations from completed actions
detective_control: Transcript review and user experience testing

risk: No owner can investigate an agent recommendation or incident
preventive_control: Assign business owners, technical owners and approval responsibilities
detective_control: Audit trail completeness and incident review
